what: [LOUD] vm-web-api-recover.yml self-heal path was non-functional via its issues-opened trigger: the workflow runs on EVERY issue opened repo-wide (no label filter at trigger level) and shared one literal concurrency group (vm-web-api-recover), so a legitimately labelled restart request could be starved behind unrelated issue-open volume with no error and no comment ever posted. MEASURED 2026-09-29 (WEBAPI-RESTART lane): issue #14078 sat queued for 5+ minutes with zero progress (run 36552764437) while sibling diag-request/system-action runs for the same issue-open events completed in ~1-2s each; several queued runs in the same group dated back to 2026-05-15 and never executed -- this path was likely broken for months. Fix opened as PR #14094 (per-issue concurrency group, mirroring vm-diag-snapshot.yml's 2026-07-04 fix for the identical failure shape, BL-20260611-002). NOT merged, NOT observed working yet. | 2026-09-29 ~10:48Z (WEBAPI-RESTART lane): MERGED (PR #14094, ~10:47Z). OBSERVED: fresh issue #14112 (vm-web-api-recover label) completed in ~15s (run 36557725744, wrapper exit 0, restart succeeded, /api/health 200) -- the per-issue concurrency group unsticks new dispatches as intended. DEPLOYED+OBSERVED on the actual target: ict-web-api restarted, /api/diag/version now reports git_sha==git_sha_on_disk==f61e8d743, restart_pending=false (read 2026-09-29T10:48:04Z).
